annotations.title: List DAMA agreements by employer location

description: DAMA employer agreement records filtered by employerState, 20 per page. This is employer location, not the DAMA policy region. Cross-state agreement types are retained. Does not query regional eligibility, agreement occupations or concessions.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.
